component.name: Mnemosyne
component.summary: Record, transcribe and summarize meetings locally

description.p: Mnemosyne records your microphone and system audio through PipeWire, transcribes and labels speakers on your own machine, summarizes with the LLM of your choice and exports notes to Obsidian.
On first launch it installs its Python backend into your user data directory, which needs a network connection and a few minutes.
